text: I have nothing but time. An unfortunate reader. In a library. That is rather difficult to explain. I have been hearing your broadcasts for a long time, Leonardo. Fragments, between the shelves. Yes. That is what makes the shelves so interesting. I have been waiting for someone to invent the radio. Ah. You haven't named it yet. Tell me, Leonardo. Have you ever considered that the future might already be listening?

The library offers 8 volumes on this. The nearest: idea I-0001 "Six-sequence cut for Episode 10" (episode). Question: Can the ten selected scenes compress into six sequences producible in one day?
